tbesh_html:
Aramaic of ba.vel (בָּבֶ֫ל, בָּבֶל "Babylon" H0894)
§ Babel or Babylon = "confusion (by mixing)"
Babel or Babylon, the ancient site and/or capital of Babylonia (modern Hillah) situated on the Euphrates

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire}
